visual_description: The image shows Shannon Miller seated outdoors on a white metal chair, smiling at the camera while holding seven Olympic medals by their ribbons in her right hand. She wears a blue button-up shirt and white pants, with a watch on her left wrist. In the upper left corner is a quote attributed to her: “One of the hardest and most important things we have to learn is to ask for help and accept help when it is offered.” The top right reads “OVARIAN CANCER.” A small inset photo in the lower right shows her as a young gymnast performing on beam, captioned: “Shannon Miller won seven Olympic medals during her gymnastics career.” Page footer indicates “Summer 2021 magazine.medlineplus.gov 19.” No charts, tables, diagrams, or axes are present.
